documents.title: Style Guide: Color Palette
documents.description: Color tokens for light and dark mode: brand, semantic, text, background, and border groups with hex values and usage rules.

documents.title: Style Guide: Typography
documents.description: Font families (Inter, Poppins, Fira Code), size scale, weights, line heights, and heading defaults.

documents.title: Style Guide: Spacing and Layout
documents.description: 4 px base spacing scale, 12-column layout grid, breakpoints, border radius, border width, shadows, and z-index scale.

documents.title: Style Guide: Motion and Interaction
documents.description: Transition durations, easing curves, standard transition presets, focus states, reduced-motion rules, and loading indicator patterns.

documents.title: Style Guide: Customization Guide
documents.description: Rules for overriding brand and semantic color tokens per project, including the override contract, contrast requirements, and step-by-step process.

documents.title: Style Guide: Component Patterns
documents.description: Reusable UI component specifications: Button, Form Input, Card, Badge/Chip, and Toast — covering anatomy, states, variants, and accessibility requirements.

documents.title: Style Guide: Iconography
documents.description: Lucide icon library rules: sizing scale, color conventions using currentColor, accessibility requirements for icon-only and icon+label elements.

documents.title: Style Guide: Voice and Tone
documents.description: Language personality, grammar rules, button label patterns, error message structure, empty state copy, confirmation dialog copy, and capitalization reference.

documents.title: Style Guide: Interaction Patterns
documents.description: Standard UX patterns for form validation, empty states, loading states, error handling, and navigation (tabs, breadcrumbs, modals, drawers, drag-and-drop).

documents.title: Style Guide: Overview
documents.description: Entry point to the UX style guide: structure overview, customization policy, design principles, and platform scope.
